target_customer: Developers and companies building health, fitness and wellness apps that need wearable and health data
problem: Each wearable and health data source has its own API, SDK and format. Terra offers one unified API that normalizes data from many devices and apps.
product_category: unified health and wearable data API

founders.name: Kyriakos Eleftheriou
founders.background_notes: YC page describes him as a weight lifter and ex-Special Forces member; no employers or education listed. TechCrunch 2021 mentions a second co-founder without naming them.

competitors.name: Validic
competitors.what: Health and wearable data integration platform, early in the space

competitors.name: Human API
competitors.what: Health data API platform, early in the space; acquired by LexisNexis Risk Solutions in March 2023

technical_complexity.rationale: Many integrations and normalization across wearables, with SDKs and Bluetooth planned, is standard but wide engineering for four people in 2021.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations create switching costs for developers, but each provider can restrict access; Terra's own blog covers Strava ending its API and Garmin pausing its developer program, and rivals like ROOK offer the same.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition of Terra found; Human API was acquired by LexisNexis in 2023 while Terra stayed independent and active.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in June 2021 reported nearly 100 developers using Terra and framed it as a Plaid for fitness data with consumption pricing.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryterra.co with try prefix, not terra.com; the name is shared with Terra (LUNA) crypto and many others.
branding.brand_signature: Positioned as the Plaid for fitness data in 2021 press
branding.community_and_virality: Runs a startup accelerator giving up to $100,000 in API credits.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic name that collides with other Terra brands; a developer community and accelerator exist but there is no press about the brand itself.

pivots.from: API to connect apps to wearables
pivots.to: AI health agents and health scores for developers
pivots.why: Not stated; YC page lists newer launches such as Tyran and OdinAI

outcome_analysis: Terra raised a 2.8 million dollar seed in June 2021 from General Catalyst, Samsung Next and NEXT VENTURES, and was still active and shipping in 2026. It depends on wearable providers' API policies, which Garmin and Strava changes have disrupted, and no later round was found, so scale is unproven.
notes: Company website was not fetched separately; the company blog was seen via search. Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Seed confirmed by TechCrunch and CB Insights (same $2.8M, June 2021). CB Insights shows $3.3M over 4 rounds and Welcome to the Jungle a $0.2M Feb 2021 seed, unverified. Founded year not found. Competitors come from an industry blog and undated comparison pages; no 2021 dated source naming rivals was found, though TechCrunch in 2021 named none.
